LanguageData.QualityBuilder.ExcludeMechsTooltip: Mechanoids are excluded from the best-builder skill calculation and cannot take quality-designated construction. Manually prioritized (forced) orders still work. Useful when you want to train your colonists' Construction on quality builds instead of letting mechs take them.
LanguageData.QualityBuilder.DefaultSettingsActiveNote: This map is using the Default settings below. Tick "Use these map settings" on the Current map page to give this map its own independent settings.
LanguageData.QualityBuilder.DefaultSettingsInactiveNo: This map is using its own settings, so changes on the Default settings page will not affect it. Untick "Use these map settings" to hand control back.
LanguageData.QualityBuilder.DefaultSettingsNoMapNote: No colony is loaded, so only these Default settings exist right now. Once you load a colony, any map can be switched to its own independent settings.
LanguageData.QualityBuilder.GizmoOnBlueprintsOnly: Show quality gizmo only on blueprints/frames
LanguageData.QualityBuilder.GizmoOnBlueprintsOnlyTool: Hides the QualityBuilder toggle gizmo and its right-click quality menu on finished buildings, restoring the pre-finished-buildings behavior. Blueprints and in-progress frames are unaffected. Existing designations and rebuild cycles keep working.
